program.name: Show Off
program.subject: Strip & show-off
program.blurb: Shoulders, arms, chest and back in quick supersets: the muscles that look good naked in a doorway.
program.about: For a V-shape and arms that fill a sleeve, and look better naked when she undresses you. Shoulders and arms one day, chest and back the next, all in supersets so it's over fast, and a short abs block to finish. Nothing heavy enough to leave you sore for the evening. Level II asks for heavier weights, Level III adds reps.
